description: Defines interfaces for grain storage operations in Orleans, including methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, with support for concurrency control via ETags and cancellation tokens.

classes.name: IStorage
classes.description: Interface providing methods for operating on grain storage with support for concurrency, including reading, writing, and clearing state, and managing ETags.

classes.name: IStorage<TState>
classes.description: Generic interface extending IStorage, adding a property for the grain state.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method that clears the grain state with a cancellation token.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method that writes the grain state with a cancellation token.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method that reads the grain state with a cancellation token.
